sections.heading: Type power
lines: Water moves and poison moves are 1.5× stronger.
Apple Acid, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Smack Down, and Thousand Waves also count as Poison for type matchups.
Sludge Wave also counts as Water for type matchups.
Water moves also count as Poison for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acid, Acid Spray, Apple Acid, Brine, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Smack Down, and Thousand Waves: 1.5× stronger.
Spikes and Toxic Spikes: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Poison-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Blizzard, Glaciate, and Subzero Slammer change the field into Icy. The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.
Tidy Up changes the field into Water Surface once their uses add up to 2 (Tidy Up 1).
Purify and Whirlpool change the field into Water Surface once their uses add up to 2 (Purify 2 and Whirlpool 2). The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin or Water Absorb restores 1/8 of its HP.

Each turn, grounded Pokémon that are not Steel or Poison-type (not those using Dive) without Immunity, Magic Guard, Pastel Veil, Poison Heal, Surge Surfer, Toxic Boost, or Wonder Guard lose 1/8 of their maximum HP (hurt by the toxic water).
This field sweeps away entry hazards.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Speed +1, is wrapped in a veil of water (Aqua Ring), and suffers bad poison.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
